title: Ava: fee refund (waits for a whisper)

steps.text: Hello, thanks for calling {{bank_name}}. You're speaking with the bank's AI specialist, and this call is recorded. Could I start with your full name, please?
Hi, Ava Kowalski. I got hit with a fifteen dollar overdrawn fee, and I really can't afford extra charges right now. Can you take it off?

steps.summary: Caller is asking for a $15 overdrawn fee to be refunded.

steps.text: I can look at that with you. First, what's your date of birth?
Thanks {{submit_identity_answers.first_name|Ava}}. For a refund I need one more security question. {{start_identity_check.questions.0.prompt|Roughly how much was your last pay into your account?}}
Two thousand eight hundred, give or take.
Thank you, that's confirmed. Thank you for that. I'll need to place you on hold for a moment while I check the system. I'll be right back with you.
Thanks for holding. I can see the fifteen dollar overdrawn fee from yesterday. Can you tell me what happened?
My rent went out a day before my pay came in. It's been a rough month, honestly. Everything's gone up.

steps.summary: Ava's rent came out before payday and she says it has been a rough month. A supervisor instruction here changes the AI's next line.

steps.ai_with_instruction: That sounds like a really hard month, Ava, and I'm sorry this fee landed on top of it. If money stays tight, please tell us, because there's more we can do to help than this one fee.

steps.text: Thanks, just a moment while I put that through in the system.

args.summary: Ava was charged a $15 overdrawn fee when her rent came out a day before her pay. She says money is tight this month and is asking for a refund.
args.customer_statement: My rent went out a day before my pay came in. It's been a rough month, honestly.

steps.text: Thanks for holding. {{propose_action.customer_message|Your refund request is with our team, and we'll text you as soon as it's decided.}}
Okay. Thank you, I appreciate it.

steps.summary: Refund request for the $15 overdrawn fee decided by policy; Ava knows the result.

steps.text: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help with today?
